name: voicesu
description: Real-time IPA vowel tracker in the browser

scripts.test: node test/dsp.test.js && node test/mapping.test.js && node test/pipeline.test.js && node test/calibration.test.js && node test/wasm.test.js
scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path wasm/Cargo.toml && cp wasm/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/voicesu_formants.wasm wasm/formants.wasm
